units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 66a:8">Kidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>היה ש׳ שמחה וכ׳</he> he rejoiced greatly (prepared a great festival), and invited &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 9b:2-18">Ib. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>אדם … וש׳ במצות</he> he is a great man and glad when he can do good.

<cite ref="Megillah 10b:8">Meg. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>אין הקב״ה ש׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord does not rejoice over the downfall of the wicked; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׂמֵחִים</he>, <he>שְׂמֵחִין</he>, <cite ref="U01498"><he>שְׂמֵי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 21b:10">Yoma 21ᵇ</cite> <he>עניים ש׳ … עצבין</he> the poor are glad (because provisions will be cheap), and the property owners are sorry; <cite ref="Bava Batra 147a:12">B. Bath. 147ᵃ</cite>.

Cant. R. to I, 10; Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ bot. והיו הדברים ש׳ וכ׳ and the words (of the Law which they quoted at the festive board) were as bright as when they were delivered from Sinai; a. fr.—Fem. שְׂמֵחָה, שְׂמֵי׳.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite> <he>כשנתן … ארץ ש׳ ושמים בוכין</he> when the Lord gave Israel the Law, the earth was glad, and the heavens wept; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׂמֵחוֹת</he>, <cite ref="U01498"><he>שְׂמֵי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite> <he>בפנים ש׳</he> with a cheerful contenance; a. e.
